summary: Marco Casario assesses the macroeconomic landscape as stock indices continue trading around all-time highs amid ongoing tariff threats and central bank hesitation. He categorizes the current economic environment as an overheating reflationary regime, driven by sticky wage growth and a resilient labor market. Consequently, he announces plans to scale back risk exposure in August by taking partial profits on equities and increasing cash reserves. He demonstrates this tactical shift directly within his broker portfolio by reducing tech holdings and adding to gold.
tone_evidence: The speaker repeatedly urges prudence, noting that market euphoria is running hot and explicitly stating that he is actively lowering his risk profile by trimming stock positions.

key_points.point: Markets are in an overheating reflationary cycle marked by resilient wage growth and stabilizing inflation.
The Federal Reserve is reluctant to loosen policy prematurely, increasing the likelihood that interest rate cuts are postponed to December.
A temporary short squeeze or technical rebound in the US dollar could push EUR/USD back toward 1.15.
European manufacturing sentiment via the German Ifo index shows recovery, but trade war risks with the US pose major headwinds.
Casario shows his portfolio, reducing equity weights in S&P 500 and individual names like Amazon and Palantir while purchasing more gold.

predictions: The US dollar could stage a short-term rebound against major currencies such as the euro, yen, and Swiss franc.
The EUR/USD exchange rate may pull back toward approximately 1.15 in the near term.
Federal Reserve rate reductions are likely to be pushed back toward December rather than September.
catalysts: August 1 deadline regarding potential US tariffs on European goods
Upcoming US Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) report in early August
Upcoming US Consumer Price Index (CPI) release in early August
Upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate decisions later in the year
title: Mercati INARRESTABILI: ma il mio MONEY MANAGEMENT cambia (abbasso il RISCHIO)
author: Marco Casario EXTRA
